qs.q: Lead poisoning causes a porphyria-like syndrome by inhibiting
o: Inhibits porphobilinogen deaminase, causing an acute intermittent porphyria-like picture
Inhibits ALA dehydratase and ferrochelatase, causing ALA and zinc protoporphyrin accumulation
Inhibits uroporphyrinogen decarboxylase alone, causing severe cutaneous lesions
Inhibits ferrochelatase alone, causing protoporphyrin accumulation in red blood cells
qs.e: Lead inhibits two enzymes: ALA dehydratase (early in pathway) → ALA accumulates (similar to AIP — can cause abdominal pain + neurological features) AND ferrochelatase (late) → zinc incorporated instead of iron → elevated ZPP in RBCs (useful screening test). Also causes: microcytic anaemia (basophilic stippling), encephalopathy, peripheral neuropathy (wrist/foot drop), renal tubular dysfunction (Fanconi syndrome). Tre
